fields.Line_Items.LineItemDescription: Water Charge, Sewer Charge, Stormwater Fee

notes.Curr_Meter_Reading/Prev_Meter_Reading: This bill has no actual meter register readings - only 'Water Usage: 4,580 gallons' for the current period and a comparison bar chart showing 'July 2026: 4,900 gallons' (the prior month's total usage, not a prior register reading). Unlike the -scan and -render-spanish siblings (which do have From/To register numbers), there's nothing here to read as a genuine meter reading. LLM's values (4,580 / 4,900 gallons) are period-usage totals, not register readings - treated as not derivable.
notes.Line_Items: LLM only captured 1 of the 3 usage-detail rows.
notes.is_total_amount_greater_than_equal_to_cu: Tot_Amt equals Total_Current_Charges here ($48.76 = $48.76), so the 'greater than or equal to' check is true.
notes.Dates: Printed as MM/DD/YYYY ('08/01/2026', etc.); normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here, consistent with every other date field in this schema. This is an AWS-managed blueprint (water-and-sewer-bill) whose field descriptions instruct MM/DD/YYYY - not ours to edit - but since these are single-value (not list) date fields, extraction-compare's normalizer resolves BDA's MM/DD/YYYY to the same calendar date, which now counts as an exact match.
